name: PopoverBase
root: none (context only); the content is a div with role dialog in the theme's portal container

keys.effect: opens the popover and moves focus into it
closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger

focus.initial: opening moves focus to the content's element with autofocus, else its first focusable element, else the content
focus.movement: native Tab order inside the content; focus may leave it, because the dialog is non-modal
focus.restoration: closing with Escape, the Close part, or the trigger returns focus to the trigger unless the reader moved it elsewhere

accessibleName: the content is named by its Title, or by its own aria-label or aria-labelledby; the trigger by its text
